description.en: Abortion in Rhode Island costs about $299 to $1,400 self-pay in 2026 (more in hospital). Pill vs procedure prices and your Good Faith Estimate rights.

h1.en: How Much Does an Abortion Cost in Rhode Island in 2026?
h1.es: Cuanto Cuesta un Aborto en Rhode Island en 2026?

subhero.en: Abortion costs about $299 to $1,400 self-pay in Rhode Island in 2026 at clinics, and $1,400 to $5,000 or more in a hospital operating room. Medication abortion (the pill) runs roughly $299 to $750 depending on telehealth, Planned Parenthood of Southern New England, or the Women & Infants Hospital Early Options Clinic. Surgical abortion at a Providence clinic runs about $600 to $1,000 through the second trimester. Rhode Island Medicaid can pay for abortion with state funds, and the No Surprises Act gives self-pay patients a written Good Faith Estimate.
subhero.es: El aborto cuesta unos $299 a $1,400 de pago propio en clinicas de Rhode Island en 2026, y de $1,400 a $5,000 o mas en un quirofano de hospital. El aborto con medicamentos (la pastilla) cuesta aproximadamente $299 a $750 segun sea por telehealth, Planned Parenthood of Southern New England o la Clinica Early Options de Women & Infants Hospital. El aborto quirurgico en una clinica de Providence cuesta unos $600 a $1,000. Medicaid de Rhode Island puede pagar el aborto con fondos estatales, y la Ley de No Sorpresas da a los pacientes de pago propio un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, abortion in Rhode Island costs about $299 to $750 for medication abortion (pill), $600 to $1,000 for surgical abortion at a clinic, and $1,400 to $5,000 or more in a hospital operating room, based on Planned Parenthood of Southern New England and Women & Infants Hospital published fees and a Brown University 2024 estimate of $600 to $1,400 for most self-pay patients. Medicare pays $0 under the 2026 Physician Fee Schedule for the bundled S0199 code and covers abortion only under Hyde exceptions. Rhode Island Medicaid can cover abortion with state funds under a 2023 law. Under the No Surprises Act, Rhode Island providers must give self-pay patients a written Good Faith Estimate before the appointment.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, el aborto en Rhode Island cuesta unos $299 a $750 para aborto con medicamentos (pastilla), $600 a $1,000 para aborto quirurgico en clinica, y $1,400 a $5,000 o mas en un quirofano de hospital, segun tarifas publicadas de Planned Parenthood of Southern New England y Women & Infants Hospital y un estimado de Brown University de 2024 de $600 a $1,400. Medicare paga $0 bajo la Lista de Tarifas de Medicos 2026 para el codigo S0199 y cubre el aborto solo bajo excepciones Hyde. Medicaid de Rhode Island puede cubrir el aborto con fondos estatales bajo una ley de 2023. Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, los proveedores de Rhode Island deben dar a los pacientes de pago propio un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito antes de la cita.

introParagraphs.en: Rhode Island protects abortion access under the Reproductive Privacy Act of 2019, which codified Roe v. Wade and permits abortion before viability, and after viability when needed to protect the patient's life or health. Rhode Island has no gestational ban before viability in 2026. KFF's Rhode Island abortion policy profile (status as of April 2026) reports that Rhode Island Medicaid, private insurance, and ACA marketplace plans do not restrict abortion coverage, although the state does not require coverage either. The result is a state where legal access is stable but price and insurance behavior still vary a lot between a telehealth pill, a Providence clinic, and a hospital operating room.
introParagraphs.es: Rhode Island protege el acceso al aborto bajo la Ley de Privacidad Reproductiva de 2019, que codifico Roe v. Wade y permite el aborto antes de la viabilidad, y despues de la viabilidad cuando es necesario para proteger la vida o la salud de la paciente. Rhode Island no tiene prohibicion gestacional antes de la viabilidad en 2026. El perfil de politicas de aborto de Rhode Island de KFF (estado a abril de 2026) indica que Medicaid, los seguros privados y los planes del mercado ACA no restringen la cobertura de aborto, aunque el estado tampoco exige la cobertura.

introParagraphs.en: Rhode Island has a small number of abortion providers, concentrated in Providence. Planned Parenthood of Southern New England (PPSNE) operates the Broad Street health center in Providence and telehealth services. Women & Infants Hospital, part of Care New England, runs the Early Options Clinic, which offers care from about 5 weeks through 22 weeks and 6 days. National telehealth providers also serve Rhode Island patients with medication abortion. Brown University's campus health guide, last updated July 2024, says most Rhode Island and Massachusetts patients who pay out of pocket pay $600 to $1,400. Patients comparing options should ask each provider for an itemized Good Faith Estimate that separates the procedure, sedation, lab work, and follow-up.
introParagraphs.es: Rhode Island tiene pocos proveedores de aborto, concentrados en Providence. Planned Parenthood of Southern New England (PPSNE) opera el centro de salud de Broad Street en Providence y servicios de telehealth. Women & Infants Hospital, parte de Care New England, opera la Clinica Early Options, que ofrece atencion desde aproximadamente las 5 semanas hasta las 22 semanas y 6 dias. Proveedores nacionales de telehealth tambien atienden a pacientes de Rhode Island. La guia de salud de Brown University, actualizada en julio de 2024, indica que la mayoria de los pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo pagan de $600 a $1,400. Los pacientes deben pedir un Estimado de Buena Fe detallado a cada proveedor.

introParagraphs.en: Abortion cost in Rhode Island in 2026 is covered here in six parts: the price by method and gestational age, the clinic versus hospital difference, what Rhode Island Medicaid, Original Medicare, and ACA-compliant plans cover, how to request a Good Faith Estimate under the No Surprises Act, self-pay and abortion fund options, and billing errors to check. Abortion is not a USPSTF preventive service, so standard plan cost-sharing applies when coverage exists. For federal poverty level thresholds that drive sliding-scale pricing, see the CoveredUSA federal poverty level page, and for the federal rules, see cms.gov/nosurprisesact and kff.org.
introParagraphs.es: El costo del aborto en Rhode Island en 2026 se cubre aqui en seis partes: el precio por metodo y edad gestacional, la diferencia entre clinica y hospital, lo que cubren Medicaid de Rhode Island, Medicare Original y los planes ACA, como solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, opciones de pago propio y fondos de aborto, y errores de facturacion. El aborto no es un servicio preventivo de USPSTF, por lo que se aplica el costo compartido normal del plan cuando hay cobertura.

explanationParagraphs.en: Rhode Island abortion cost in 2026 depends most on whether care is delivered at a clinic or a hospital. Planned Parenthood of Southern New England's Providence health center lists self-pay fees of $600 for medication abortion up to 11 weeks and $600 to $995 for surgical abortion from under 12 weeks to 19 weeks and 6 days (with local anesthesia or sedation), according to Brown University's campus guide, last updated Fall 2022, so 2026 fees may be higher and should be confirmed by phone. Women & Infants Hospital's Early Options Clinic lists $750 for medication abortion and states that surgical cost depends on whether the procedure is done in the outpatient clinic (under 10 weeks) or in an operating room. Hospital operating room cases carry facility fees that clinics do not.
explanationParagraphs.es: El costo del aborto en Rhode Island en 2026 depende sobre todo de si la atencion se brinda en una clinica o en un hospital. El centro de Providence de Planned Parenthood of Southern New England lista tarifas de pago propio de $600 para aborto con medicamentos hasta las 11 semanas y de $600 a $995 para aborto quirurgico, segun la guia de Brown University actualizada en el otono de 2022, por lo que las tarifas de 2026 pueden ser mas altas y deben confirmarse por telefono. La Clinica Early Options de Women & Infants Hospital lista $750 para aborto con medicamentos. Los casos en quirofano de hospital incluyen cargos de instalacion que las clinicas no tienen.

explanationParagraphs.en: Rhode Island hospital billing follows the same structure as other states: a chargemaster list price far above what insurers pay, plus separate professional, anesthesia, and pathology bills. A 2022 Boston Globe report found Rhode Island abortion bills could start near $600 and exceed $5,000 when complications or operating room care were involved. Under the No Surprises Act, Rhode Island hospitals must give uninsured and self-pay patients a Good Faith Estimate that lists each of these components, and most Rhode Island hospitals offer a self-pay or financial assistance discount if asked. Patients with an uncomplicated pregnancy under the clinic gestational cutoff generally pay the lower clinic price.
explanationParagraphs.es: La facturacion hospitalaria de Rhode Island sigue la misma estructura que otros estados: un precio de lista (chargemaster) muy superior a lo que pagan las aseguradoras, mas facturas separadas de profesionales, anestesia y patologia. Un reportaje del Boston Globe de 2022 encontro que las facturas de aborto en Rhode Island podian comenzar cerca de $600 y superar $5,000 con complicaciones o atencion en quirofano. Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, los hospitales de Rhode Island deben dar a los pacientes sin seguro o de pago propio un Estimado de Buena Fe que liste cada componente.

explanationParagraphs.en: Rhode Island patients who need care later in pregnancy have fewer options and may need an operating room at Women & Infants Hospital, or may travel to nearby Massachusetts or Connecticut clinics, adding transportation and lodging costs. Rhode Island abortion funds and national networks can help with both procedure and travel costs. Federally Qualified Health Centers in Rhode Island offer sliding-scale fees for reproductive health services, though not all perform abortions, so call ahead. For household income thresholds that determine sliding-scale eligibility, see the federal poverty level page linked below.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los pacientes de Rhode Island que necesitan atencion mas tarde en el embarazo tienen menos opciones y pueden necesitar un quirofano en Women & Infants Hospital, o viajar a clinicas cercanas de Massachusetts o Connecticut, lo que agrega costos de transporte y alojamiento. Los fondos de aborto de Rhode Island y las redes nacionales pueden ayudar con los costos del procedimiento y del viaje. Los Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente de Rhode Island ofrecen tarifas en escala movil, aunque no todos realizan abortos.

Los rangos hospitalarios reflejan tarifas de chargemaster antes de descuentos. Confirme las tarifas actuales por telefono y solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe.

paragraphs.en: Medicare coverage of abortion is limited by the Hyde Amendment to cases of rape, incest, or a pregnancy that endangers the patient's life. Original Medicare Part B covers abortion in those exceptions only, with 20% coinsurance after the 2026 Part B deductible of $283, and the 2026 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule allows $0 for the bundled S0199 code because it is not a Medicare-payable service. Medicare Advantage plans are not required to cover abortion beyond the Hyde exceptions, and Medigap supplements pay the 20% coinsurance only for services Original Medicare covers. Very few Medicare beneficiaries seek abortion, but those who do should expect to pay the full price outside the Hyde exceptions. See the CMS fee schedule tool at cms.gov for code lookups.
paragraphs.es: La cobertura de Medicare para el aborto esta limitada por la Enmienda Hyde a casos de violacion, incesto o un embarazo que pone en peligro la vida de la paciente. Medicare Original Parte B cubre el aborto solo en esas excepciones, con coseguro del 20% despues del deducible de la Parte B de 2026 de $283, y la Lista de Tarifas de Medicos de Medicare 2026 permite $0 para el codigo agrupado S0199 porque no es un servicio pagable por Medicare. Los planes Medicare Advantage no estan obligados a cubrir el aborto mas alla de las excepciones Hyde, y Medigap solo paga el coseguro de servicios que Medicare Original cubre.

paragraphs.en: Rhode Island Medicaid, administered by the Executive Office of Health and Human Services (EOHHS), can cover abortion with state funds. Governor Daniel McKee signed a 2023 law on May 18, 2023, repealing the state restriction that barred coverage except for rape, incest, or danger to the patient's life, and KFF's Rhode Island profile (status as of April 2026) reports no Medicaid abortion coverage restriction. A separate federal provision from H.R.1 barred Medicaid payments to certain Planned Parenthood affiliates for one year and expired July 4, 2026, but patients should ask PPSNE directly whether Rhode Island Medicaid is accepted on the appointment date. ACA-compliant plans sold through HealthSource RI and employer plans are not restricted by Rhode Island from covering abortion, though the state does not require coverage, so check your Summary of Benefits and Coverage.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid de Rhode Island, administrado por la Oficina Ejecutiva de Salud y Servicios Humanos (EOHHS), puede cubrir el aborto con fondos estatales. El gobernador Daniel McKee firmo una ley el 18 de mayo de 2023 que derogo la restriccion estatal que prohibia la cobertura salvo violacion, incesto o peligro para la vida, y el perfil de KFF (estado a abril de 2026) no reporta restriccion de cobertura en Medicaid. Una disposicion federal de H.R.1 prohibio pagos de Medicaid a ciertos afiliados de Planned Parenthood por un ano y expiro el 4 de julio de 2026, pero las pacientes deben preguntar directamente a PPSNE si aceptan Medicaid de Rhode Island. Los planes ACA de HealthSource RI y los planes de empleadores no estan restringidos por Rhode Island, aunque el estado no exige cobertura.

paragraphs.en: Commercial plans that cover abortion treat it like other outpatient procedures: a deductible, then coinsurance or a copay, with high deductible plans requiring the patient to pay the full negotiated rate until the deductible is met. Prior authorization is uncommon for abortion but is worth confirming. A plan's negotiated rate at a hospital can be lower than the chargemaster list price but higher than a clinic's self-pay price, so patients should compare the clinic cash price to their out-of-pocket cost under insurance before choosing which to use. Abortion is not a USPSTF preventive service, so it does not carry the zero cost-sharing guarantee that applies to USPSTF Grade A and B screenings.
paragraphs.es: Los planes comerciales que cubren el aborto lo tratan como otros procedimientos ambulatorios: un deducible, luego coseguro o copago, y los planes de deducible alto requieren que la paciente pague la tarifa negociada completa hasta cumplir el deducible. La autorizacion previa es poco comun pero conviene confirmarla. La tarifa negociada de un plan en un hospital puede ser menor que el precio de lista (chargemaster) pero mayor que el precio de pago propio de una clinica. El aborto no es un servicio preventivo de USPSTF, por lo que no tiene la garantia de costo compartido cero.

paragraphs.en: Under the No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, any Rhode Island patient who is uninsured or chooses to pay out of pocket has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate from the provider before the abortion. For care scheduled at least 10 business days out, the Good Faith Estimate is due at least 3 business days before service. For care scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, it is due at least 1 business day before service. The Good Faith Estimate must include itemized expected charges, procedure codes, the provider's name and NPI, and the total expected cost. The federal starting point is cms.gov/nosurprisesact, and healthcare.gov explains the protections in plain language.
paragraphs.es: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, cualquier paciente de Rhode Island sin seguro o que elija pagar de su bolsillo tiene derecho a un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito del proveedor antes del aborto. Para atencion programada con al menos 10 dias habiles de anticipacion, el Estimado de Buena Fe vence al menos 3 dias habiles antes del servicio. Para atencion programada en 3 a 9 dias habiles, vence al menos 1 dia habil antes. El punto de partida federal es cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

paragraphs.en: To request a Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in Rhode Island in 2026, follow these five steps: (1) Call PPSNE, Women & Infants Hospital, or the telehealth provider and say you are self-pay or uninsured. (2) Ask for a written Good Faith Estimate that itemizes the procedure fee, sedation or anesthesia, lab work such as Rh typing, ultrasound, pathology, and the follow-up visit. (3) Give your gestational age and planned add-ons, such as sedation versus local anesthesia. (4) Confirm the timing: 3 business days before service if scheduled 10 or more business days out, or 1 business day before if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out. (5) Keep the written Good Faith Estimate. If the final bill exceeds it by $400 or more, you have 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Common reasons the final bill changes include a gestational age confirmed at a higher tier, sedation upgrades, pathology specimens, extra ultrasound time, and Rh immunoglobulin.
paragraphs.es: Para solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe para un aborto en Rhode Island en 2026, siga estos cinco pasos: (1) Llame a PPSNE, Women & Infants Hospital o al proveedor de telehealth e indique que paga de su bolsillo o no tiene seguro. (2) Solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito que detalle el procedimiento, sedacion o anestesia, laboratorio como tipificacion Rh, ultrasonido, patologia y la visita de seguimiento. (3) Indique su edad gestacional y servicios adicionales. (4) Confirme el tiempo: 3 dias habiles antes del servicio si esta programado con 10 o mas dias habiles, o 1 dia habil antes si es en 3 a 9 dias habiles. (5) Conserve el Estimado de Buena Fe. Si la factura final lo supera en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una disputa en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

items.en: Gestational age and method: Rhode Island abortion cost in 2026 rises with each gestational range. PPSNE's published fees step up from $600 under 12 weeks to $885 to $995 at 16 to 19 weeks and 6 days (Fall 2022 listing), and medication abortion is generally limited to about 11 weeks at PPSNE.
items.es: Edad gestacional y metodo: el costo del aborto en Rhode Island en 2026 aumenta con cada rango gestacional. Las tarifas publicadas de PPSNE suben de $600 antes de las 12 semanas a $885 a $995 a las 16 a 19 semanas y 6 dias, y el aborto con medicamentos se limita a unas 11 semanas en PPSNE.

items.en: Site of service: a Providence clinic or telehealth visit costs far less than a hospital operating room in Rhode Island. Hospital bills add facility fees tied to the chargemaster, plus separate anesthesia and pathology bills, which is why operating room cases can reach $1,400 to $5,000 or more in 2026.
items.es: Sitio de servicio: una clinica de Providence o una visita de telehealth cuesta mucho menos que un quirofano de hospital en Rhode Island. Las facturas hospitalarias agregan cargos de instalacion ligados al chargemaster, mas facturas separadas de anestesia y patologia.

items.en: Insurance status: Rhode Island Medicaid can cover abortion with state funds, ACA-compliant plans on HealthSource RI are not restricted by the state but are not required to cover it, and Original Medicare covers only Hyde exceptions. Patients with a high deductible plan often pay the full negotiated rate anyway, so compare it against the clinic cash price.
items.es: Estado del seguro: Medicaid de Rhode Island puede cubrir el aborto con fondos estatales, los planes ACA de HealthSource RI no estan restringidos por el estado pero no estan obligados a cubrirlo, y Medicare Original cubre solo excepciones Hyde.

items.en: Independent clinic self-pay bundles: PPSNE and telehealth providers quote flat prices that bundle the visit, medications or procedure, and follow-up. Clinic self-pay bundles in Rhode Island run well below hospital operating room cash prices in 2026 (about $600 to $1,000 versus $1,400 to $5,000 or more). Ask what the all-inclusive price covers.
items.es: Paquetes de pago propio en clinicas independientes: PPSNE y los proveedores de telehealth cotizan precios fijos que agrupan la visita, los medicamentos o el procedimiento y el seguimiento. Pregunte que cubre el precio total.

items.en: Hospital chargemaster discount ask: Rhode Island hospitals publish financial assistance and self-pay discount policies, and uninsured patients can ask for a reduction from the chargemaster price, often 20 to 60 percent. Some discounts apply automatically for uninsured patients; others require a written request before or after service.
items.es: Descuento sobre el chargemaster del hospital: los hospitales de Rhode Island publican politicas de asistencia financiera y descuentos de pago propio, y los pacientes sin seguro pueden pedir una reduccion del precio de lista, a menudo del 20 al 60 por ciento.

items.en: Sliding-scale FQHCs and Medicaid eligibility: Federally Qualified Health Centers in Rhode Island charge by household size and income, and fees can be $0 below 100 percent of the 2026 federal poverty level ($15,650 for a household of 1). Not every FQHC performs abortion, so call first. See the CoveredUSA federal poverty level and Medicaid income limits pages for thresholds.
items.es: FQHC con escala movil y elegibilidad de Medicaid: los Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente de Rhode Island cobran segun el tamano del hogar y los ingresos, y las tarifas pueden ser $0 por debajo del 100 por ciento del nivel de pobreza federal de 2026 ($15,650 para un hogar de 1). No todos realizan abortos, llame primero.

items.en: Abortion funds and travel: the Rhode Island Abortion Fund and national networks such as the National Abortion Federation hotline can help pay for the procedure and travel when care is needed beyond clinic gestational limits. No Rhode Island state screening program applies to this procedure, and the CDC NBCCEDP and CRCCP programs do not cover abortion.
items.es: Fondos de aborto y viaje: el Rhode Island Abortion Fund y redes nacionales como la linea de la National Abortion Federation pueden ayudar a pagar el procedimiento y el viaje. Ningun programa estatal de deteccion de Rhode Island aplica a este procedimiento.

intro.en: Abortion billing in Rhode Island can include unexpected line items, especially when a procedure is billed through a hospital. Check these patterns before paying any bill in 2026:
intro.es: La facturacion del aborto en Rhode Island puede incluir cargos inesperados, sobre todo cuando se factura por un hospital. Revise estos patrones antes de pagar cualquier factura en 2026:

items.en: Separate anesthesia or pathology bill arriving weeks later: these should appear on the Good Faith Estimate if anticipated. If the total exceeds the estimate by $400 or more, file a patient-provider dispute within 120 days.
items.es: Factura separada de anestesia o patologia semanas despues: deben aparecer en el Estimado de Buena Fe si se anticipaban. Si el total supera el estimado en $400 o mas, presente una disputa dentro de 120 dias.

items.en: Hospital facility fee on care delivered in a clinic setting: confirm whether the bill is from the hospital outpatient department or the clinic, and dispute the facility fee if the place of service was a clinic.
items.es: Cargo de instalacion hospitalaria por atencion en entorno de clinica: confirme si la factura es del departamento ambulatorio del hospital o de la clinica.

items.en: Ultrasound billed twice: once inside the abortion package and again as a diagnostic imaging charge.
items.es: Ultrasonido facturado dos veces: dentro del paquete de aborto y otra vez como imagen diagnostica.

items.en: Rh typing or Rh immunoglobulin billed as a separate lab encounter: routine pre-procedure labs should be included in the quoted price.

en.question: How much does an abortion cost without insurance in Rhode Island in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance in Rhode Island in 2026, medication abortion costs about $299 to $499 through telehealth and $600 to $750 at Planned Parenthood of Southern New England or the Women & Infants Hospital Early Options Clinic. Surgical abortion at a Providence clinic runs about $600 to $1,000 depending on gestational age and sedation, using the most recent published fees. Hospital operating room care can run $1,400 to $5,000 or more at chargemaster prices. Brown University's 2024 guide estimates most self-pay Rhode Island patients pay $600 to $1,400. Always request a written Good Faith Estimate.

en.question: What does Medicare pay for an abortion in 2026?
en.answer: Original Medicare Part B pays for abortion only under the Hyde exceptions: rape, incest, or a pregnancy that endangers the patient's life. In those cases, the beneficiary owes 20 percent coinsurance after the 2026 Part B deductible of $283. The 2026 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule allows $0 for the bundled S0199 code because it is not a payable service. Medicare Advantage plans generally follow the same limits, and Medigap pays the 20 percent coinsurance only on covered services. For elective abortion, a Medicare beneficiary should plan to pay the full self-pay price.

en.question: How do I request a Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in Rhode Island?
en.answer: Under the No Surprises Act, call the Rhode Island clinic, hospital, or telehealth provider and say you are self-pay or uninsured. Ask for a written Good Faith Estimate itemizing the procedure or medication, sedation, labs, ultrasound, pathology, and follow-up, and share your gestational age. The provider must deliver it 3 business days before service if scheduled 10 or more business days out, or 1 business day before if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out. Keep it. If your final bill is $400 or more above the estimate, you have 120 days to file a dispute at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

en.question: What is the No Surprises Act and does it apply to abortion in Rhode Island?
en.answer: The No Surprises Act took effect January 1, 2022, and requires providers and facilities to give uninsured and self-pay patients a written Good Faith Estimate before scheduled care. It applies to Rhode Island clinics, hospitals, and telehealth practices, including those providing abortion, with no exemption for reproductive health services. It also limits out-of-network balance billing for emergency care and for certain out-of-network clinicians at in-network facilities for insured patients. Medicare and Medicaid have their own protections. The federal resource is cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

en.question: How do I get a written cash-pay quote for an abortion in Rhode Island?
en.answer: Call your Rhode Island provider before scheduling and say you are paying out of pocket, then ask for the all-inclusive cash price at your gestational age. Ask whether it includes sedation, labs, ultrasound, pathology, and follow-up, and whether income-based discounts exist. Request the quote in writing as a Good Faith Estimate. At hospitals, also ask for the self-pay discount off the chargemaster price. Compare the cash price with your plan's deductible and coinsurance before deciding whether to use insurance, particularly if you have a high deductible plan.

en.question: Can I negotiate an abortion bill after the fact in Rhode Island?
en.answer: Yes. If a bill exceeds your written Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, you can file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim within 120 days of the bill date at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Even without a Good Faith Estimate overage, patients can ask the billing office for a cash-pay-now discount, often 30 to 50 percent below the billed amount, a hardship reduction, or a payment plan. Hospital billing offices also run financial assistance programs. The Rhode Island Abortion Fund may help with outstanding balances, so contact them as early as possible.

en.question: What is the difference between hospital and clinic abortion cost in Rhode Island?
en.answer: In Rhode Island in 2026, a Providence clinic charges roughly $600 to $1,000 for a surgical abortion through the second trimester under the latest published fees, while a hospital operating room case can run $1,400 to $5,000 or more. Hospitals bill facility fees from a chargemaster list price and add separate anesthesia and pathology charges. Medication abortion is $299 to $750 at clinics and telehealth versus higher hospital outpatient billing if used. Clinics generally cannot handle later gestational ages or complex medical cases, which is when hospital care is needed.

en.question: Will my insurance cover an abortion in Rhode Island?
en.answer: Rhode Island does not restrict abortion coverage in Medicaid, private insurance, or ACA marketplace plans according to KFF (status as of April 2026), but the state does not require coverage either. Rhode Island Medicaid can pay with state funds under a 2023 law. ACA-compliant plans on HealthSource RI and employer plans vary, so check your Summary of Benefits and Coverage or call member services. Abortion is not a USPSTF preventive service, so deductibles and coinsurance can apply. Original Medicare covers only Hyde exceptions.

en.question: What is the difference between medication abortion and surgical abortion in Rhode Island?
en.answer: Medication abortion uses mifepristone followed by misoprostol and is available in Rhode Island through about 11 weeks at PPSNE and from about 5 weeks at Women & Infants Hospital, via telehealth or in person, for $299 to $750 in 2026. Surgical abortion uses vacuum aspiration or dilation and evacuation in a clinic or operating room, at $600 to $1,000 at a Providence clinic and more in a hospital. Medication abortion carries a small chance of incomplete abortion requiring follow-up. Surgical abortion is available at later gestational ages. Both are billed differently, so ask which codes apply.

en.question: What financial help is available for abortion in Rhode Island in 2026?
en.answer: Rhode Island patients can combine several sources. The Rhode Island Abortion Fund and national networks such as the National Abortion Federation hotline may pay part or all of the procedure and help with travel. PPSNE and other clinics may offer sliding-scale or financial assistance pricing. Rhode Island Medicaid can cover abortion with state funds for eligible patients, and hospitals publish financial assistance discounts off the chargemaster. Federally Qualified Health Centers charge sliding-scale fees, though not all perform abortions. Contact funds early because their money is limited.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta un aborto sin seguro en Rhode Island en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro en Rhode Island en 2026, el aborto con medicamentos cuesta unos $299 a $499 por telehealth y $600 a $750 en Planned Parenthood of Southern New England o en la Clinica Early Options de Women & Infants Hospital. El aborto quirurgico en una clinica de Providence cuesta unos $600 a $1,000 segun la edad gestacional y la sedacion. La atencion en quirofano de hospital puede costar de $1,400 a $5,000 o mas. La guia de Brown University de 2024 estima que la mayoria paga de $600 a $1,400. Solicite siempre un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito.

es.question: Que paga Medicare por un aborto en 2026?
es.answer: Medicare Original Parte B paga el aborto solo bajo las excepciones Hyde: violacion, incesto o un embarazo que pone en peligro la vida de la paciente. En esos casos, la beneficiaria paga coseguro del 20 por ciento despues del deducible de la Parte B de 2026 de $283. La Lista de Tarifas de Medicos de Medicare 2026 permite $0 para el codigo S0199. Los planes Medicare Advantage generalmente siguen los mismos limites, y Medigap paga el coseguro solo en servicios cubiertos.

es.question: Como solicito un Estimado de Buena Fe para un aborto en Rhode Island?
es.answer: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, llame a la clinica, hospital o proveedor de telehealth de Rhode Island e indique que paga de su bolsillo o no tiene seguro. Pida un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito que detalle el procedimiento o los medicamentos, sedacion, laboratorio, ultrasonido, patologia y seguimiento. El proveedor debe entregarlo 3 dias habiles antes del servicio si esta programado con 10 o mas dias habiles, o 1 dia habil antes si es en 3 a 9 dias habiles. Si la factura final supera el estimado en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias para presentar una disputa en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Que es la Ley de No Sorpresas y aplica al aborto en Rhode Island?
es.answer: La Ley de No Sorpresas entro en vigor el 1 de enero de 2022 y exige que los proveedores den a los pacientes sin seguro o de pago propio un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito antes de la atencion programada. Aplica a clinicas, hospitales y practicas de telehealth de Rhode Island, incluidos los que brindan aborto, sin exencion para servicios de salud reproductiva. Medicare y Medicaid tienen sus propias protecciones. El recurso federal es cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Como obtengo una cotizacion de pago en efectivo para un aborto en Rhode Island?
es.answer: Llame a su proveedor de Rhode Island antes de programar, indique que paga de su bolsillo y pida el precio total en efectivo para su edad gestacional. Pregunte si incluye sedacion, laboratorio, ultrasonido, patologia y seguimiento, y si hay descuentos por ingresos. Pida la cotizacion por escrito como Estimado de Buena Fe. En hospitales, pregunte tambien por el descuento de pago propio sobre el precio de lista (chargemaster). Compare el precio en efectivo con el deducible y coseguro de su plan.

es.question: Puedo negociar una factura de aborto despues del procedimiento en Rhode Island?
es.answer: Si. Si la factura supera su Estimado de Buena Fe escrito en $400 o mas, puede presentar una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas dentro de los 120 dias de la fecha de la factura en cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Incluso sin exceso, puede pedir al departamento de facturacion un descuento por pago inmediato, a menudo del 30 al 50 por ciento, una reduccion por dificultad financiera o un plan de pagos. El Rhode Island Abortion Fund puede ayudar con saldos pendientes.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre el costo del aborto en hospital y en clinica en Rhode Island?
es.answer: En Rhode Island en 2026, una clinica de Providence cobra aproximadamente $600 a $1,000 por un aborto quirurgico segun las ultimas tarifas publicadas, mientras que un caso en quirofano de hospital puede costar de $1,400 a $5,000 o mas. Los hospitales facturan cargos de instalacion desde un precio de lista (chargemaster) y agregan cargos separados de anestesia y patologia. El aborto con medicamentos cuesta $299 a $750 en clinicas y telehealth. Las clinicas generalmente no atienden edades gestacionales avanzadas o casos medicos complejos.

es.question: Cubrira mi seguro un aborto en Rhode Island?
es.answer: Rhode Island no restringe la cobertura de aborto en Medicaid, seguros privados ni planes del mercado ACA segun KFF (estado a abril de 2026), pero tampoco la exige. Medicaid de Rhode Island puede pagar con fondos estatales bajo una ley de 2023. Los planes ACA de HealthSource RI y los planes de empleadores varian, por lo que revise su Resumen de Beneficios y Cobertura. El aborto no es un servicio preventivo de USPSTF, por lo que pueden aplicar deducibles y coseguro. Medicare Original cubre solo excepciones Hyde.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre aborto con medicamentos y aborto quirurgico en Rhode Island?
es.answer: El aborto con medicamentos usa mifepristona seguida de misoprostol y esta disponible en Rhode Island hasta unas 11 semanas en PPSNE y desde unas 5 semanas en Women & Infants Hospital, por telehealth o en persona, por $299 a $750 en 2026. El aborto quirurgico usa aspiracion o dilatacion y evacuacion en una clinica o quirofano, a $600 a $1,000 en una clinica de Providence y mas en un hospital. El aborto quirurgico esta disponible en edades gestacionales mas avanzadas.

es.question: Que ayuda financiera hay para el aborto en Rhode Island en 2026?
es.answer: Las pacientes de Rhode Island pueden combinar varias fuentes. El Rhode Island Abortion Fund y redes nacionales como la linea de la National Abortion Federation pueden pagar parte o todo el procedimiento y ayudar con viajes. PPSNE y otras clinicas pueden ofrecer precios en escala movil. Medicaid de Rhode Island puede cubrir el aborto con fondos estatales, y los hospitales publican descuentos de asistencia financiera sobre el chargemaster. Contacte a los fondos temprano porque su dinero es limitado.
